description: This file implements ASN.1 encoding and decoding functions for DSA keys within the OpenSSL project, including functions for public/private key encoding, decoding, comparison, and parameter management.

methods.name: dsa_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes a DSA public key from ASN.1 format into an EVP_PKEY structure.

methods.name: dsa_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes a DSA public key from EVP_PKEY into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: dsa_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes a DSA private key from ASN.1 format into an EVP_PKEY structure.

methods.name: dsa_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes a DSA private key from EVP_PKEY into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: int_dsa_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the DSA key.

methods.name: dsa_bits
methods.description: Returns the number of bits in the DSA prime p.

methods.name: dsa_missing_parameters
methods.description: Checks if DSA parameters p, q, g are missing.

methods.name: dup_bn_into
methods.description: Duplicates a BIGNUM into a provided pointer, freeing the previous value.

methods.name: dsa_copy_parameters
methods.description: Copies DSA parameters p, q, g from one EVP_PKEY to another.

methods.name: dsa_cmp_parameters
methods.description: Compares DSA parameters p, q, g between two EVP_PKEY structures.

methods.name: dsa_pub_cmp
methods.description: Compares the public keys of two DSA EVP_PKEY structures.

methods.name: int_dsa_free
methods.description: Frees the DSA key inside an EVP_PKEY structure.
